author: ukSpeedo
name: FlashNDash
short: Temporary channel posts that auto-delete after a time the poster chooses.
description: Watches a configurable channel, DMs each poster buttons (5/10/15/30 min) asking how long to leave their message up, pings a configurable role, then deletes the message and the ping when time is up.
install_msg: Thanks for installing FlashNDash! Use `[p]fnd` to configure it.
end_user_data_statement: This cog temporarily stores Discord message, channel and guild IDs until scheduled posts are deleted. It does not persistently store any user data.
